name: coolmaths-tutor
description: MCP server that serves the coolmaths games, their maths and their runnable logic as grounded tutoring material.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run golden && tsx test/http.test.mjs && tsx test/oauth.test.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build-index && tsx watch src/node.ts
scripts.test:firestore: cd ../firebase && npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-coolmaths "cd ../mcp && npx tsx test/firestore.test.mjs"
